name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.4-beta+3

- Edit layout on the page itself (Home, Movies & TV, Manga)
- TV (Flutter): stronger two-glint highlight, edit Home rows on Home itself
  - Accent at full strength (TvStyle.vivid: the colour you picked, kept bright and saturated) instead of the dark theme's pale tint.
  - Highlight: two glints going round in opposite directions; each is solid colour over the white ring (accent → a neighbouring hue) with a glow.
  - Settings → Home rows → Edit rows opens Home in edit mode: every row with its cards (hidden ones dimmed, 'Hidden'), Move lifts a row (ring round it), Up / Down carry it, OK puts it down; Hide / Show; Reset; Done.
- Test: new Home rows follow their default neighbour
- TV (Flutter): Settings on the TV, moving highlight ring
  - Highlight: TvRing, a white ring a few pixels out from the focused box with a glint in your accent colour travelling round it (Switch 2 style). On cards, category tiles, episodes and buttons. Settings → Appearance → Moving highlight turns the glint off.
  - Settings → Home rows: show / hide and order every Home row (TvHomeRows, KV plus_tv_home_rows); Home follows straight away; Reset.
  - Settings → Addons: your Stremio addons in order with their health, move up / down (saved to your Stremio account), remove (press twice), refresh.
  - Settings → Player: play the next episode (on), skip intros and recaps by themselves (off, once per intro), remembered subtitle / audio language with Forget.
  - Settings → Appearance: accent colour (AnymeX's colours).
- TV (Flutter): Categories keep loading, Library without doubles
  - A category's grid asks for the next page (AniList and TMDB) when you reach its last two rows, up to 25 pages; 'Loading more…' at the end.
  - Library: a show that's in AniList and Stremio shows once (the AniList entry); Stremio's own doubles (Kitsu and IMDb ids) too, newest kept.
- TV (Flutter): pictures and titles for anime episodes
